title: Chapter 115: Excited Players
content:
Chapter 115: Excited Players

This was a feeling he had never felt before.

It wouldn't be strange if Bond Zhao was here.

This is a manifestation of tool man's self-awakening of consciousness after receiving major stimulation during his growth process.

Of course Wang Shuo didn't understand this, and at this time, he had no intention of paying attention to his subordinates.

[System Announcement: Wang Shuo, the lord of Wana Village, led his subjects through an arduous and fierce battle and achieved a glorious victory in the "Village Defense War". Killed 11 bosses, killed the golden boss for the first time, killed 10.2 million beasts, ranked first, hereby announces. 】

The system announcement was broadcast three times in a row!

These three system announcements are like a drop of water dripping into a hot oil pan.

All chat channels that received relevant prompts exploded.

"I'll go, I won, why is there no system announcement? I don't accept it!"

"What do you have to announce? Didn't you see that he killed more than 10 million beasts? He is simply more beast than a beast. This Wana Village is definitely a monster."

"Oh my god! It's more than 10 million, but my village only has 100,000 wild beasts. I can barely defend it!"

"You seem to have missed the point. He killed 10 bosses."

"Upstairs, you didn't pay attention to the important point. He killed the golden boss for the first time. What does the golden boss look like? I really want to take a look."

"Looking away, I was scared to death, O(∩_∩)O haha~..."

"You will be scared to pee, your whole family will pee..."

"Now I just want to see who this Wang Shuo is and whether he has three heads and six arms."

"I want to give birth to a monkey for him. Do any of the sisters come with me?"

"Where is Wana Village? I want to hug my thighs. Following this kind of thighs, this survival game is a ball!"

"The same nine-year compulsory education, why is he so good?"

"Are we playing the same game? I'm only level 21, and I can't even defeat a bronze boss."

"Upstairs, you're like Versailles. You haven't considered the feelings of those of us who haven't reached level 10 yet. I despise you!"

"Hmph, has Wang Shuo considered my mood?"

"Wang Shuo is no longer comparable to us. He can only be used for worship. He is like a god of learning. We can't understand him!"

…

In the chat group, the reactions from those who survived were very intense. Wang Shuo had now reached a height that others could not reach.

Su Xiu couldn't calm down for a long time. The Jiuyuan Village he established had only killed 1.9 million beasts so far. He looked at the entire ranking list and found that the third place only had 900,000.

The combined number from second to tenth place is not as much as his.

He even went through the entire list. From him to 100, the total number of people on all the lists was still not as high as his.

There was a trace of bitterness in his heart. He was a person with a strong heart, and it was rare for anything to cause a wave of disturbance in his heart.

His ID is 6666, which is an extremely auspicious number. He has always believed that he is a person favored by fate and will be able to lead the players of Blue Star to create a prosperous era.

After a brief moment of frustration, a golden light burst out of his eyes.

He took a long breath and let out the decadence in his heart.

"No matter who he is, I am the one destined by destiny, so just regard him as a stepping stone in my growth!"

There are countless lords who feel good about themselves, who either admire, envy, or are unconvinced!

Thousands of people, thousands of faces, not just one.

…
